summary: PASS for the bounded construction slice. InvokeJev now defaults omitted mode to SHADOW and deep-copies its input; the original planner decision is captured before model IO and sealed alongside the raw model envelope. The DecisionReceipt refers to both immutable artifacts, and the independent acceptance fixture binds its exact revision through Task/AcceptanceReceipt input_refs. SHADOW model disagreement is recorded without replacing the original selection, while deterministic hard failures still force ABSTAIN. Existing qualification/authority gates keep automatic authority disabled and reject aliased executor self-signatures. All 14 required fixture assertions pass on the integrated source and exact dispatcher; no blocking implementation defect found within this card.

coverage.requirement: 1. Fixed model interface, decision point, input hash and raw recommendation
coverage.evidence: Reuses fixed typesafe-systemone-v1 adapter and scope model_revision/rubric_revision. Binding includes project, scope, input hash and rubric hash. Raw request/response envelope is sealed with hashes; new original-decision artifact records decision_point, selected/status/rationale, input refs/hash, evidence and actor before network IO.

coverage.requirement: 2. SHADOW/ADVISORY/BOUNDED_AUTO and purpose key; default SHADOW; no automatic Acceptance
coverage.evidence: Omitted mode becomes SHADOW before schema validation; caller input is copied through lossless JSON decoding. SHADOW records model reasons without changing original selected/status, except host hard failures still abstain. ADVISORY continues abstention on timeout. BOUNDED_AUTO stays refused by the existing protected-qualification gate; no Acceptance write is performed by InvokeJev/recordDecision.
coverage.qualification_limit: No claim that a qualified BOUNDED_AUTO execution path or LIVE reuse_selection qualification is delivered. Those remain W11-02/parent obligations.

coverage.requirement: 3. Compare original judgment vs Jev; replay high score/hard failure, timeout, privilege and stale version
coverage.evidence: Actual persisted signals retain REJECT while original selection remains ACCEPT in SHADOW; ADVISORY high score + FAIL produces ABSTAIN. Timeout is a real local HTTP timeout fixture. Both self-sign attempts hold VERIFIER role and are mapped to the actual executor identity, so refusal is not merely a missing-role check. A real third verifier accepts the same run. Stale ref 999 rejects before model IO.

coverage.requirement: OUTPUT. One decision links original judgment, Jev recommendation and final independent acceptance
coverage.evidence: Two distinct immutable Artifact VersionRefs are stored in the exact DecisionReceipt evidence_refs; signal raw_artifact_ref matches the model envelope. Review Task input_refs carries Ref(receipt, DecisionReceipt); accepted receipt copies the same exact input vector and independent verifier principal. The new evidence is emitted by real Service operations on SQLite, not a text-only claimed chain.

coverage.requirement: NEGATIVE. Renamed/delegated executor, high score covering hard failure and broad automatic grants fail
coverage.evidence: Observed 403 self-sign refusals under VERIFIER role plus a successful independent control, hard FAIL remains ABSTAIN, foreign-purpose/DRAFT qualification removed from decision, and BOUNDED_AUTO returns 503. Automatic authority remains NONE.

coverage.requirement: EVIDENCE. Real hashes, commands, exits and independent current review
coverage.evidence: The Python handler pins an exact 14-ID set, rejects missing/extra/duplicate rows, nonzero exits, timeouts, malformed rows, assertion mismatches or source drift. Current registered binding and all source hashes verified; original executor records preserved.

observations_and_limits.description: The cross-purpose fixture creates a DRAFT qualification with a different task_type. It therefore verifies that this unsuitable key grants no authority, but does not independently isolate mismatched scope from qualification status. Current production guard checks both, and BOUNDED_AUTO is unconditionally disabled; no acceptance blocker for this slice. Before enabling automatic authority, W11-02 must prove valid-key/wrong-key behavior with independently qualified keys.

Default SHADOW is implemented at authenticated InvokeJev host entry. The frozen CreateDecisionRequest HTTP schema still requires mode for imported receipts. This is not silently represented as a new HTTP default or a completed CLI/Desktop workflow.

The fixture task_type is evidence-validity. Full LIVE reuse_selection calibration, protected holdout, model qualification and product acceptance remain NOT_ESTABLISHED; no formal holdout data was opened. The tiny strings called holdout in the development test are synthetic fixture data only.
